actions.reason: C0001 has coherent multi-modality identity evidence (metabolic-down/immune-up RNA program, SETD2/PBRM1 mutation enrichment, coordinated chr9/CDKN2A/JAK2 loss), positive cross-modal membership support with positive fused boundaries against all other sets, and no supported technical confounding. Structure is compatible and no material unresolved question remains.

C0002 shows a coherent angiogenic/WNT/TGF-beta activation program with strong RNA effects, significant CNV features, good cross-modal membership support, and positive fused boundaries against all other sets. No technical confounding is supported and no material unresolved question remains.

C0003 is defined by a striking, coherent VHL-mutant/PBRM1-wildtype genotype with very high WXS boundary separation from all other sets and no supported technical confounding. Although cross-modal support is weak and RNA/CNV are nonsignificant, the WXS signal is strong and interpretable, and no available evidence request could resolve the remaining limitation; the candidate is retained for downstream validation.

C0004 has a coherent VHL/PBRM1-depleted genotype with significant adjusted WXS evidence and very high WXS boundary separation from all other sets, with no supported technical confounding. Cross-modal support is weak and RNA/CNV are nonsignificant, but the genotype signal is strong and interpretable and no available request could resolve the limitation; the candidate is retained for downstream validation.

C0005 shows a coherent metabolic-activation RNA program with strong effects, DST/MTOR mutation enrichment, positive fused boundaries against all other sets, and no supported technical confounding. Cross-modal support is modest and CNV is nonsignificant, but the identity signal is coherent and no available request could resolve the limitation; the candidate is retained for downstream validation.

C0006 is characterized by a strong BAP1-enriched genotype with PBRM1 depletion and a coherent interferon/immune-activation RNA program, moderate cross-modal membership support, positive fused boundaries against all other sets, and no supported technical confounding. No material unresolved question remains.
